title: Customer Channels AI Product and Delivery Expert
description:
The role leads delivery and adoption of AI powered customer channel solutions to improve customer experience and deliver measurable business value. It coordinates cross functional teams and stakeholders to implement chatbots voicebots and interaction intelligence and to drive continuous performance optimization.

We are looking for a Customer Channels AI Product & Delivery Expert to drive the delivery, adoption and continuous improvement of AI-powered customer channel solutions, including chatbots, voicebots, interaction intelligence and future AI initiatives...
